title: Uth gaya hain aaj baba zainab
body:
hogaya jab khana-e- zehra mein ek meshar bapa
thar thara uthi zameen aur asman hilne laga
aarahi thi yeh daro deewar-e- kufa se sada – 2
uth gaya hain aaj baba zainab-o-kulsum ka
1. uth gaya maula jaha se hashr ka hangam hai
zindagi be aasra hain har taraf kohram hain
hain jaha ka zarra zarra soug mein duba huwa
<<MINI>>
uth gaya hain aaj baba . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ho gaya khamosh jab se malik -e- kouno maka
chup hai mehrab -e- yaqi aur chup hai minare aza
hain dayare deen -e- ahmed par udasi ki faza
<<MINI>>
uth gaya hain aaj baba . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
3. bekaso mazloom ka hajat rawa koi nahi
ab kise awaaz de mushkil kusha koi nahi
koun dega ab sahara be saharon ko bhala
<<MINI>>
uth gaya hain aaj baba . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. ghar se bahar aana jaye bibiya rote huwe
koi suraj se yeh kehde roshni roke rahe
kar rahi hain sar khule saidaniya aaho buka
<<MINI>>
uth gaya hain aaj baba . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. surq hain ekisvi ki subha ka chehra farid
waris -e- kaaba huwa hain khanaye haq mein shaheed
subhe mehshar ka sama hain hartaraf chaya huwa
<<MINI>>
uth gaya hain aaj baba . . . . .
